small.$description: Type style Small. Rows, hints, buttons, card body.

label.$description: Type style Label. Uppercase panel headers and chips.

callout-title.$description: Callout title size, harvested from the prototype's renderCallout(). Does not match a documented type style (styles land at 13/Small or 17/Section; nothing between). Proposed as-is pending the token decisions ticket (docs/prd.md Q1-adjacent) — flagged in the PR.

micro.$description: Type style Micro. The hard floor (AGENTS.md rule 6) — nothing in Lairy is set smaller. Section numbers, meta labels, captions, uppercase codes.

body.$description: Type style Body. Rows and paragraphs — the docs page's own prose, distinct from a component's Small body text.

section.$description: Type style Section. Docs page section titles, and the docs page's opening sentence (docs/prd.md §8.2's default mapping snaps its 19px literal onto this style).

doc-title.$description: Type style Doc title. The docs page's own page title (docs/prd.md §8.2).

small.$description: Leading for Small — the Typography foundation's documented value. The prototype's own Callout body used 1.55; documented foundations win (ADR-0005), so 1.5 is used and the difference is flagged.

callout-title.$description: Callout title leading. Not specified in the prototype's inline style (browser normal ~1.2 for a single-line 600-weight label); harvested as a proposed value pending review.

section.$description: Leading for Section. docs/prd.md §8.2 lists this style's leading as "per prototype" without a fixed figure; the prototype's own section-title spans set no line-height at all (browser default), while the one wrapped use (the docs page's opening sentence, 19px → Section) used 1.55. 1.3 is a harvested middle value serving both; flagged pending the token decisions ticket.

tight-6.$description: Tracking step .06em — Callout's action-button label. One of the consolidated tracking set (docs/prd.md §8.2).

tight-neg-2.$description: Tracking step -.02em — the Doc title style's negative display tracking (docs/prd.md §8.2).
